_arm_note: mirror decides WHICH ARM gets scrubbed, not --right-arm. With mirror:true (this file) the default L_* landmarks land on the subject's RIGHT arm; --right-arm selects R_* = their LEFT. Measured in all four wave x mirror cells. Wave one arm and check the dots land on it -- if they land on the other arm, flip mirror.
_comment: HOT-RELOADS on save — no restart. Edit mid-demo if needed.
_dirt_note: set dirt_mode to 'uv' to use real fluorescence detection; tune with tools/tune_dirt.py, which prints all five dirt_* keys to paste here. All of them hot-reload.
_contact_note: -5 = press into the skin (torque feedback works); +20 = hover, per the team brainstorm — then also pass --no-contact-gate or splotches never pop
_care_api_note: seam B: the port py/careapi.py serves /api/task, /api/stop and /api/vitals on. Crystal's carechair .env points at it with ROBOT_MODE=live and ROBOT_BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8770. Read once at startup, so this key does NOT hot-reload -- moving it needs a restart.
_water_note: team brainstorm says NO WATER (damages the motors). false = scripted mode skips the bucket dip.
